title: Visible photon flux
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the number of visible photons per second per square meter at Earth using n = (0.45Pλ)/(hc).

title: Spherical area scaling
description: Important: Multiplies the photon flux by the surface area of a sphere with radius equal to the Sun-Earth distance (4πR²) to find total photons from the Sun.

title: Final photon count
description: Essential: Reports the correct numerical estimate for photons radiated by the Sun per second (~4.9×10⁴⁴ photons/s).

title: Earth's cross-sectional area
description: Important: Uses the Earth's circular cross-sectional area (πr²) rather than its surface area to calculate total received power.

title: Total power received
description: Essential: Reports the correct numerical estimate for total power received by Earth (~1.8×10¹⁴ kW).

title: Photon energy formula
description: Important: Correctly applies E_photon = hc/λ to relate photon energy to wavelength and constants.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout (e.g., converting μm to m, kW to W) without errors.

title: Wrong area for photons
description: Pitfall: Uses Earth's surface area instead of spherical area centered on Sun when calculating total photons from Sun.

title: Wrong area for power
description: Pitfall: Uses Earth's surface area instead of its cross-sectional area when calculating total received power.

title: Omits visible fraction
description: Pitfall: Fails to multiply by 0.45 when calculating visible photon flux, using total power instead.
